title: Expense claim
passage: Who can approve my travel expenses? A. Your department manager handles those. B. The train was quite expensive. C. By the end of the month.
passageZh:
誰可以核准我的差旅費用？
A. 這類差旅費用由你的部門經理負責處理。
B. 火車費用相當昂貴。
C. 在月底以前。
